newsitem.title: USA: U.S.plane-makers seen opposing fuel tank proposals.
newsitem.headline: U.S.plane-makers seen opposing fuel tank proposals.

text.p: Airlines and aerospace companies are expected to oppose all but one of the federal proposals intended to prevent fuel-tank explosions aboard airliners, the Wall Street Journal reported Thursday.

In a report to be delivered to the Federal Aviation Administration, the aviation industry says most of the measures recommended by the National Transportation Safety Board would not significantly improve safety and could add new risks to complex modern airliners, the newspaper said.

The one change that carriers and plane makers see as having possible merit would add insulation to air conditioning systems in order to prevent them from heating the fuel stores above them, the report said.
The newspaper cited "people familiar with official industry findings" for its report.
